n: const APP_VERSION="v21";(()=>{const run=()=>{const root=document.querySelector("#app")||document.body;const heads=[...root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,[role=heading]")].filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null);const sales=heads.some(e=>/laporan\s+penjualan/i.test(e.textContent||""));const pnl=heads.some(e=>/laporan\s+laba\s+rugi/i.test(e.textContent||""));if(!sales||pnl)return;for(const e of [...root.querySelectorAll("*")]){if(e.offsetParent===null||e.children.length>4)continue;const t=(e.innerText||e.textContent||"").trim().replace(/\s+/g," " );if(!/omset|pendapatan/i.test(t)||t.length>180)continue;let p=e;for(let i=0;i<6&&p.parentElement;i++){const q=p.parentElement;if(q.matches("section,article,.card,[class*=card],[class*=stat],[class*=metric],[class*=summary],[class*=report]")){p=q;break;}p=q;}if(p&&p!==root){p.style.setProperty("display","none","important");p.setAttribute("data-omset-hidden","v21");}}};new MutationObserver(run).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});run();})();
